demos.name: Customer Agent LAB
demos.description: The customer-facing AI agent with all 87 use cases, each routed Here, Here + go deeper, Hand off or Guide. AI-DEMO2-depth movie reel, sequence view and step detail in movable cards; hand-offs to 30 labs whose Back strip resumes the chat; an A2A page; Scripted or llama.cpp brain. Mock runs offline.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5600). Docker: HOST_PORT=5603 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Settings: the app's own .env beside docker-compose.yml (copy .env.example; Docker takes only SHELF_URL, CAL_LAB_MODE and LAB_ALLOWED_HOSTS from it, never the PingOne settings). Live (host-run only, owner opt-in: CAL_ALLOW_LIVE=1, IDP=pingone, PINGONE_ENVIRONMENT_ID, PINGONE_REGION, PINGONE_CLIENT_ID, PINGONE_CLIENT_SECRET in that .env) makes two real calls to one PingOne environment. Live was owner-verified 2026-11-05 with the old shared settings file; it is UNVERIFIED after the move to the app's own .env until the owner re-checks it. Catalog id D24.
